title.narrative: CULTURE IN PUBLIC POLICIES: Advancing Culture Across the UN Agenda and Post-2030 Framework

description.narrative: Support UNESCO's leadership and Member State engagement on culture within United Nations intergovernmental processes at UN Headquarters. Activities will include substantive support to champions of culture for the organization of ambassadorial- and expert-level meetings and preparation of joint statements; advocacy to strengthen the integration of culture in discussions on sustainable development, peace and security, and emerging technologies, including AI; support to Member States during negotiations of relevant General Assembly and Security Council resolutions; development of partnerships with New York- and US-based cultural institutions; strategic monitoring and reporting on UNHQ developments, including UN80 and preparations for the post-2030 framework.
